description: This file defines the Ruleset class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically under the EndpointV2 ruleset subsystem. The class is responsible for managing a collection of rules, parameters, and helper functions used to determine appropriate endpoints or errors based on input parameters.

classes.name: Ruleset
classes.description: A collection of rules, parameter definitions, and helper functions used to resolve endpoints or errors based on input parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Ruleset with provided rules and partitions, setting up parameters, rules, and the standard library.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the ruleset.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the parameters defined in the ruleset.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Returns the list of rules in the ruleset.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the input parameters against the ruleset, returning the first matching rule or false if none match.

methods.name: validateInputParameters
methods.description: Validates input parameters against parameter definitions, applying defaults where necessary.

methods.name: createParameters
methods.description: Creates parameter objects from parameter definitions.

methods.name: createRules
methods.description: Creates rule objects from the list of rule definitions using RuleCreator.
